status: Frozen before first matching run; thresholds are not acceptance criteria
primary: LSR 13 pages, 3 independent mutations per error kind, always reset to baseline
holdout: NIST archived PDF pages 6, 9, 10; baseline noise only
selection: Document-order quantiles floor((n-1)*q), q = 0.2, 0.5, 0.8; never filter by match quality
paragraphs: Core paragraph blocks with at least 80 characters
numbers: Eligible paragraphs containing an ASCII digit; increment the first digit modulo 10
order: Move selected paragraph after the next eligible paragraph using Core moveBlock
cells: Nonempty table cells in row-major document order, at least 4 characters
detection: New unmatched evidence tokens, relative to baseline, cover at least half the target tokens matched at baseline AND half all target tokens. Numeric change requires both a newly unsupported changed digit and a newly missing original digit. Order requires a newly unmatched exact run of 8 or more tokens present on both sides within the affected interval.
alerts: One nonempty LCS edit gap per PDF page; adjacent insert/delete are one gap. Never merge separate gaps to meet the noise criterion.
normalization: Whitespace, Unicode letter NFKC/ligatures, soft hyphen, letter-hyphen-newline-lowercase-letter. Preserve case, numbers, superscripts, subscripts, units and comparison symbols.
noiseRule: PDF-only: pure page number at outer 8 percent OR exact repeated edge line at outer 8 percent on at least 3 selected pages. No numeric masking for repetition. No picture/table/formula exclusion.
